page_title: CRY 1-1 LUT | Crystal Palace v Luton 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+6' 1 - 1 Goal! Andros Townsend hands Cauley Woodrow (Luton) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
90+5' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the crossbar.
90+3' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+3' Crystal Palace hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90+1' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Luke Berry (Luton) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
90+1' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Tahith Chong makes way for Zack Nelson (Luton).
87' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Jordan Clark is replaced by Luke Berry (Luton).
87' Chiedozie Ogbene goes off the pitch and Andros Townsend (Luton) comes on.
86' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
84' Alfie Doughty (Luton) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
83' It looked like the long-range shot by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
81' Rob Edwards is forced to make a change. Gabriel Osho is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Cauley Woodrow (Luton).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) comes onto the pitch so that Jean-Philippe Mateta can be given a rest.
81' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Adam Wharton and he is replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
79' Gabriel Osho (Luton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
78' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
77' Tahith Chong (Luton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

74' What a save from Thomas Kaminski! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
73' Issa Kabore (Luton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sam Johnstone intercepts the ball.
70' Substitution. Jordan Ayew walks off the pitch and Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
70' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Daiki Hashioka (Luton), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar.
70' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
69' The resulting corner from Alfie Doughty (Luton) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Luton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

67' Carlton Morris (Luton) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Sam Johnstone.
66' Issa Kabore (Luton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
64' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Daiki Hashioka (Luton) is replacing Teden Mengi.
59' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Thomas Kaminski is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
59' Teden Mengi (Luton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
58' Teden Mengi (Luton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
57' Reece Burke (Luton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
56' Alfie Doughty (Luton) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
54' CHANCE! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
52' Issa Kabore (Luton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
50' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) brings an opponent down and Sunny Gill interrupts the game.
48' Alfie Doughty (Luton) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
47' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
46' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Gabriel Osho (Luton) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly over the bar.
45+3' Issa Kabore (Luton) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
45+1' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) picks up a long through ball, but Thomas Kaminski deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
41' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
39' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
37' Crystal Palace have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
36' Referee Sunny Gill sees the trip by Teden Mengi (Luton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
35' Some great controlled play and passing from Luton. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
34' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
32' Tahith Chong (Luton) tries to find Chiedozie Ogbene, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
30' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), but it's just over the bar.
29' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) prepares to take a corner kick.
29' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
29' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
29' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
27' The whistle blows and Issa Kabore (Luton) is booked for an infringement.
26' Jordan Clark (Luton) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
25' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
24' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
17' Good clearance! Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
16' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
15' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
15' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but it's cleared.
13' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
11' 1 - 0 GOAL! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Daniel Munoz provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 1:0.
9' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Thomas Kaminski comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Ross Barkley (Luton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
5' The game is interrupted now, Ross Barkley (Luton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
5' Ross Barkley (Luton) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
3' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alfie Doughty (Luton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Luton will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Sunny Gill.
